# Draft:Howard Dudley ware

----
References
Hitchhiked to 48 us states, 6 provinces, and 7 states in Mexico by the time he was 17 years old. Started his journey from Dallas to Gastown  in Vancouver BC when he was 15, eventually wound up in Wash.DC for 15 years. He has shaken hands with some notable people, some lm not to proud of, like Usama bin Laden when he had his bus parked in the middle of Lafayette Square in front of the White House on 07/04/1977 during one of the Smoke ins On a July 4th. His group were the people that supplied the Afghan weed to us Yippies that year, where Mr. Ware got arrested that year for Distribution of Marijuana for passing out joints to the protesters. Also Mr. Ware shook hands with the Donald in the mid 80’s one late night in Georgetown while him, and his two bodyguards were looking for the young college girls after hours party, that did not exist. Mr. Ware pulled away from his hand shake, because he was pulling him closer like a bully, and because he escaped his grip Donnyboy had his two goons grab him, and punched him. I directed the man to 14th St., where the prostitutes hung out at that time. To confirm the story, all you have to do is ask Oprah whom I met at the Restaurant, Piel de coucion on Wisconsin Ave. that night. Her entourage were trying to get me to call the cops on him,and I heard for the first time the phrase “Teflon Don”, coming out of Oprah’s mouth. She is the one that originally asked me what I wanted to do in life, and I have been nursing for the past 35 years now, still strugling, because I am only an LVN, but I raised 4 kids, and now I help my baby girl raise her two kids. Even though I stay broke, Life is good here in Abilene Texas. Sources include, Washington DC Park Police, Washington DC police Department, Oprah Winfrey, and the National Archives where Usama parked his bus in the middle of Lafayette Square that year on July 4th 1977.
